text:
devon: Quick design sync on the sequencer UI tweaks. Dropping a Figma link + GIF of keyboard reorder: https://fig.redwood/s/seq-reorder-v4.gif

devon: Main goals: make priority ordering obvious, tighten validation copy, and close a11y gaps (focus ring, ordering announcement, contrast).

priya: Nice! Two immediate copy asks:
- Replace "Rule priority" tooltip with "Execution priority (higher runs first)"
- For the inline overlap pill, try: "Overlap: rule #<id> also matches" instead of generic "Conflict". Helps people act faster.

sam: UI nit: the small drag handle icon is low-contrast on the gray row hover state. Suggest using the primary accent at 80% opacity for the handle hover rather than full white. Also add a visible 2px focus ring on keyboard grab.

kevin: Accessibility checklist: role=list + aria-label="Routing rules" for the container. Each item should have aria-posinset/aria-setsize so SR reads "Rule 2 of 6". When reordering announce: "Moved rule X to position Y" via aria-live polite.

aria: QA test cases:
- Reorder via keyboard (Space grab, ArrowMove, Enter drop) and ensure voiceover announces new index.
- Contrast: run against WCAG AA for normal text and for the drag handle icon.
- Colorblind: swap icons for color-independent affordance (dashed grip lines + label).
- Validation flow: when overlap detected, focus shouldn't jump — instead show inline pill and an optional toast that links to preview.

priya: Regarding the preview sim: can we include an explicit "Simulate request" input with a small JSON payload and show the evaluated path? It's helpful to reproduce edge cases.

sam: Implementation note: if we run the simulation client-side against cached routing data, ensure we invalidate cache on rule reorder/save. Otherwise preview will mislead users.

kevin: For microcopy on the preview drawer header: "Preview request routing" (title) and subhead: "Simulate a request to see which rule will handle it. Results reflect current unsaved changes."

priya: Small accessibility wording: instead of "Open preview", voiceover users prefer more context: "Open routing preview, simulates current rule order" for the button aria-label.

devon: Good catch. I'll update the component spec: add aria-posinset, aria-setsize, aria-grabbed on the handle, and aria-live region for validation. Also add prefers-reduced-motion support for the reorder animation.

sam: One last UX debate: do we autoscroll the moved item into center of the list when dragging far distances? Autoscroll is nice, but it can be disorienting for SR users. If we do it, only trigger with a visible toast that says "Item moved to X" so SR users get context.

preview-bot: Snapshot ready: https://preview.redwood.internal/snapshots/1772003456-seq-v4.png

devon: I'll make the copy changes and a small dev ticket for index-based focus state + aria announcements. Leaving in review until EOD for any objections. :+1:
